Given c, spike--slab mixture (DIF-free majority negligible tau0, plus directional DIF slab) gives item posterior DIF probability, shrunken DIF estimate local-FDR flag. what: Validation (known truth, 12 replications per size, inst/validation/known_truth.R)
title: Score Comparability for Translated and Adapted Exams
text: 60 items; reference n = 2,000; translated group 0.5 logits lower; ~35% items carry adaptation features make mostly harder translation. DIF detection (items DIF > 0.2 logits, target FDR 10%): EB power every size meets FDR target n = 200. n ≤ 100 FDR runs target (12–19%), sizes treat flags candidates expert translation review, conclusions. DIF effect estimation (RMSE, logits), EB shrinkage vs raw differences: 0.26 vs 0.38 (n = 50), 0.20 vs 0.26 (n = 100), 0.16 vs 0.20 (n = 200). DIF-free items error falls two-thirds (e.g. 0.11 vs 0.38 n = 50); genuinely large DIF shrunk somewhat toward slab mean. Linking (true shift 0.5): Mean linking biased directional DIF, data fix . weighted mode beats every size roughly tied iterative purification . broader benchmark (180 data sets: balanced, directional heavy DIF n = 50/100/200; dev/bench_link.R) lowest overall RMSE nine estimators (0.114, vs 0.119 purification, 0.137 mean linking 0.164 joint mixture used earlier development). 90% intervals cover true shift 94% time. Impact: 90% intervals pass-rate change cover truth 92% replications n = 150 (true mean change -3.0 points, estimated -1.9). Features: idiom, cultural referent, units vocabulary effects recovered (true 0.60 / 0.50 / -0.40 / 0.35; mean estimates 0.62 / 0.52 / -0.42 / 0.29), 95% CI coverage 83–100%.

text: calibration `td_calibration`. fdr Target Bayesian false discovery rate flagging. tau0 SD DIF among "DIF-free" items: scale DIF considered negligible (logits). anchor_max Items posterior DIF probability reported anchors. link `"mode"` (default) `"mixture"`. ambiguity Competing-mode density ratio linking reported ambiguous.

title: Robust linking, anchor selection and small-sample DIF — td_dif
text: `td_dif` object: `$items` (`item`, `d`, `se_d`, `p_dif`, `lfdr`,   `dif_mean`, `dif_sd` (posterior mean/SD DIF), `flag`, `anchor`),   `$link` (`c`, `c_se`, `pi0`, `m1`, `tau0`, `tau1`, `alt_c`, `alt_ratio`),   baseline linking constants `c_mean` (items anchors)   `c_purified`, `weakly_identified` (TRUE, warning,   second item cluster nearly dense chosen one).

title: Robust linking, anchor selection and small-sample DIF — td_dif
text: **Linking.** default `c` precision-weighted *mode* `d_i`: center densest cluster items, found maximizing `sum_i phi((d_i - c) / s_i) / s_i` `s_i^2 = se_i^2 + tau0^2`. assumes DIF-free items form largest cluster, DIF cancels mean linking . known-truth benchmarks across balanced, directional heavy DIF, lowest overall RMSE estimators compared (including mean linking, iterative purification, median, Tukey biweight, least trimmed squares joint mixture ). SE sandwich estimate plus scales' location variance. second cluster items nearly dense, linking flagged ambiguous competing shift reported. **DIF.** Given `c`, DIF effects follow spike--slab mixture: DIF-free items (share `pi0 > 0.5`) `delta_i ~ N(0, tau0^2)`, DIF items `delta_i ~ N(m1, tau1^2)`, `m1` allows directional DIF. item gets posterior DIF probability, shrunken DIF estimate local false discovery rate. `link = "mixture"` instead estimates `c` jointly mixture (approach version 0.1.0; kept comparison).

code: sim <- td_simulate(n_ref = 400, n_focal = 120, n_items = 20, seed = 5) dif <- td_dif(td_calibrate(sim$responses, sim$group)) rep <- td_report(dif, td_impact(dif, cut = 12, n_draws = 50, seed = 1),                  td_features(dif, sim$features), c("English", "French")) cat(rep) #> # Score comparability: English vs French forms #>  #> ## Samples #> - English: 400 examinees; French: 120 examinees. #>  #> ## Linking and anchors #> - The French group's mean ability is estimated at -0.62 logits relative to the English group (SE 0.25). #> - This estimate relies on DIF-free items forming the largest cluster of items (estimated DIF-free share: 50.0%), not on DIF cancelling out. Linking with all items as anchors would have given -0.61. #> - 0 items qualify as clean anchors (posterior DIF probability below 0.2). #>  #> ## Item-level DIF #> - 3 of 20 items are flagged (Bayesian false discovery rate 10.0%). #>  #> | item | DIF (logits) | posterior SD | P(DIF) | direction | #> |---|---|---|---|---| #> | Q15 | -0.57 | 0.21 | 0.97 | easier in French | #> | Q10 | +0.43 | 0.24 | 0.88 | harder in French | #> | Q16 | +0.38 | 0.24 | 0.85 | harder in French | #>  #> ## Aggregate impact #> - Expected pass rate of the French group: 22.7% on the translated form vs 22.7% on a DIF-free form; change +0.1 points (90% interval -7.9 to +7.3). #> - An examinee exactly at the cut is expected to score +0.01 raw points on the translated form (interval -1.01 to +1.40). #>  #> ## What predicts DIF (guidance for translators) #> | feature | DIF per feature (logits) | SE | p | #> |---|---|---|---| #> | units | -0.46 | 0.15 | 0.001 | #> | cultural | +0.55 | 0.20 | 0.006 | #> | vocabulary | +0.26 | 0.13 | 0.050 | #> | idiom | +0.21 | 0.19 | 0.275 | #>  #> Residual DIF SD not explained by features: 0.11 logits. #>  #> ## Notes for review #> - Flagged items call for expert review of the translation before any statistical adjustment. #> - Conclusions assume the Rasch model holds in both groups and that most items are DIF-free. #> - Frame decisions using the fairness chapter of the Standards (AERA, APA, NCME, 2014) and the ITC Guidelines for Translating and Adapting Tests (2nd ed., 2017). # To save: td_report(dif, file = file.path(tempdir(), "comparability.md"))

title: transDIF 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Per-group Rasch calibration relative standard errors (td_calibrate()). Robust linking precision-weighted mode item differences, sandwich SE warning two item clusters equally plausible, small-sample DIF detection empirical-Bayes spike--slab model local false discovery rates (td_dif()), plus Mantel-Haenszel baseline (td_mh()). td_features() drops item features variation (warning) instead failing. Aggregate pass-rate impact linking DIF uncertainty (td_impact()). Item-feature meta-regression draft comparability report (td_features(), td_report()).
